items.definition:
relating to or using magic; enchanting
The children believed in the magical powers of the fairy.

unpleasant or unkind
That was a nasty comment to make.

serving no purpose; without use
This broken tool is completely useless.

sharp, unpleasant taste; resentful
The coffee was very bitter without sugar.

relating to Egypt
We visited the Egyptian museum.

having a great deal of money, resources, or assets
He became a wealthy businessman.

giving freely
She is very generous with her time.

faithful
He is a loyal friend.

using radio waves rather than wires
I bought a new wireless mouse.

far away
We could see a distant light in the darkness.

covered with sand
We walked along the sandy beach.

not feeling physically or mentally at ease
I felt uncomfortable in the tight shoes.

not clothed or covered
He walked across the bare floor.

without end
The children had endless energy to play all day.

relating to or situated in the tropics
Brazil has a tropical climate.

not needed
It's unnecessary to bring a coat; it's warm outside.

having or showing creative skill
She has a very artistic talent.

difficult or impossible to understand, explain, or identify
She received a mysterious package in the mail.

not based on or behaving according to the principles of equality and justice
It was unfair to blame him for the mistake.

causing death
The snake's venom was deadly.

full of rocks; unstable
The path was rocky and difficult to climb.

fitting in well with a person's needs, activities, and plans
The store is very convenient, just a short walk from my house.

old or aging
The elderly couple enjoyed their quiet life.

fast; quick
The gazelle is a swift runner.

requiring immediate action
This is an urgent matter that needs our attention.

upright; perpendicular to the horizontal
The cliff face was almost perfectly vertical.

teenage
He has two teenage children.

alike
The two sisters look very much alike.

flexible
Yoga helps you become more flexible.

having special abilities or training
She is a highly skilled worker.

physically strong and active
He has a very athletic build.

willfully causing pain or suffering to others
It was cruel to leave the dog alone in the rain.

having bad luck; regrettable or inappropriate
It was an unfortunate accident, but no one was seriously hurt.

relating to teeth or dentistry
She has a dental appointment next week.

not severe, harsh, or extreme
The weather was mild for this time of year.

lacking consideration for others; concerned chiefly with one's own personal profit or pleasure
It was selfish of him to take the last piece of cake.

of or relating to the face
She received a facial massage at the spa.

loyal, true, and constant
The dog was a faithful companion.

corresponding in color, pattern, or style
She bought a matching hat and scarf.

causing a sudden, disturbing feeling of surprise or horror
The news was absolutely shocking.

not limited or restricted
The plan offers unlimited calls and data.

feeling or showing worry, nervousness, or unease
She felt anxious about her upcoming exam.

unable to be seen
The tiny particles were invisible to the naked eye.

soft or easily chewed; gentle and loving
The meat was very tender.

Extraordinary, especially in being very good or impressive.
You look absolutely fabulous in that outfit!

light in color or shade; (of a person's face) having less color than usual
She looked pale after the long flight.

not able to be believed; astonishing
The story was absolutely unbelievable.

pleasant or attractive
The old village was very charming with its narrow streets.

wretchedly unhappy or uncomfortable
I felt miserable after catching the flu.

adorable
The puppy was absolutely adorable.

ashamed
She felt ashamed of her behavior.

of a greater age
My elder sister is a doctor.

allowing a two-way flow of information
The museum has many interactive exhibits.

thin, slender
She has a very slim figure.

providing encouragement or help
My family has always been very supportive of my decisions.

causing an unpleasant feeling of fear or unease
That old abandoned house looks really creepy.

coming between two things in time, place, order, character, etc.
This course is for intermediate learners.

of little depth
The water in the pool is very shallow at this end.

relating to Arabia or its language
He is learning to speak Arabic.

relating to the North Pole region
The Arctic region is home to polar bears.

keen or enthusiastic
She was eager to start her new job.

easily broken or damaged
The butterfly has delicate wings.

not direct in course or connection; roundabout
We took an indirect route to avoid traffic.

without clothes; naked
The artist painted a nude figure.
